description: Ex-Luftwaffe Republic F-84F Thunderstreak in early Bundeswehr markings DE+121, preserved by the tradition association of Jagdbombergeschwader 41, the wing that flew the type from Husum.
Ex-Luftwaffe Alpha Jet A, c/n 0143, held by the Traditionsgemeinschaft JaBoG 41 at Rantrum near Husum.
